official_measurement_examples.name: Current Approved Document J
official_measurement_examples.fact: Approved Document J is the 2010 edition incorporating 2010, 2013 and 2022 amendments and covers air supply, combustion products, fire protection and fuel storage.

official_measurement_examples.name: 2022 CO amendment commencement
official_measurement_examples.fact: The 2022 Approved Document J amendments took effect on 1 October 2022.

official_measurement_examples.name: CO alarm installation scope
official_measurement_examples.fact: The 2022 change extended guidance for carbon monoxide alarms alongside installation of fixed combustion appliances of any fuel type, excluding gas cookers.

official_measurement_examples.name: Rented-sector regime separation
official_measurement_examples.fact: The Smoke and Carbon Monoxide Alarm regulations impose landlord duties that are separate from Part J Building Regulations compliance.

official_measurement_examples.name: Repair duty
official_measurement_examples.fact: The 2022 rented-sector guidance requires landlords to repair or replace faulty alarms after being informed and finding them faulty.

official_measurement_examples.name: Local authority enforcement
official_measurement_examples.fact: Local housing authority enforcement of rented-sector alarm duties is a separate regime from Building Control enforcement of Part J.

official_measurement_examples.name: Consultation versus law
official_measurement_examples.fact: The 2020 consultation proposals are historical policy evidence; the operative 2022 changes must be read from the final guidance and regulations.

official_measurement_examples.name: Planning separation
official_measurement_examples.fact: Part J compliance, landlord alarm duties and planning permission remain distinct legal questions.

core_rules: Approved Document J compliance is not planning permission
planning permission is not Part J compliance
CO alarm requirement is not proof a combustion appliance is lawfully installed
fixed combustion appliance presence is not evidence of fuel-network capacity
gas cooker exclusion must not be generalized to all gas appliances
rented-sector alarm duties are distinct from Part J building-control duties
landlord alarm compliance is not building-control completion
building-control compliance is not landlord-regulation compliance
local housing authority alarm enforcement is not planning enforcement
consultation proposal is not operative law after final regulations are made
historic pre-2022 CO guidance must retain its date and scope
flue or chimney design compliance is not a planning permission
fuel storage compliance is not environmental-permit approval
Part J compliance does not establish ownership or utility rights
NO_DATA must remain NO_DATA rather than no combustion constraint
no parcel combustion clearance or Future Growth score may be promoted while recovery is parked
